title: minimize-toolchain-footprint-and-add-idempotent-release-hook-runner
author: Maya Chen
description: Summary: Reduce developer CI image size and presubmit runtime by replacing monolithic dev toolchains with a slim multi-stage container and introduce an idempotent release hook runner that guarantees once-only execution for release automation. Motivation: Presubmit builds have grown slow due to heavy container layers and duplicated toolchain installs; release automation occasionally triggered duplicate hooks in edge cases (race on tag creation and webhook retries). Goals: (1) Provide a hermetic slim Dockerfile with explicit bootstrap and a light runtime image for tests so local dev + CI reuse layers; (2) Move expensive setup steps to a cacheable build-stage and use a small runtime image for presubmit; (3) Implement an idempotent release hook runner (go) that persists run-state to the control-plane API and retries safely; (4) Add a shallow preflight dry-run gate to the release workflow to catch common failures earlier. Changes: Added tools/ci/docker/Dockerfile.slim and tools/ci/docker/entrypoint-slim.sh; refactored .github/workflows/presubmit.yml to use the slim image and to parallelize lint/unit shards; created ci/release-hooks/runner.go and ci/release-hooks/README.md describing the idempotency model; updated scripts/release/preflight.sh to perform a lightweight checksum and tag-existence probe before invoking hooks; bumped action versions for setup-go and actions/cache to reduce transitive deps; added a small integration test harness ci/harness/test_release_hooks.sh that simulates webhook retries. Testing: local build of slim image (image size reduced by ~420MB), CI presubmit matrix runtime reduced 22% on average in smoke buckets, end-to-end simulation for release hooks validated against retries and network blips. Deploy: rollout is safe-by-default; feature flag ci.slots.release_hook_idempotency = on for 48 hours, followed by gradual enable. Notes: This PR intentionally avoids touching the main runtime images used for Dedicated; it only optimizes CI/dev toolchains and release hook runner behavior.

Maya Chen (author): Addressed both; split out node runtime and moved go toolchain to build-stage; reduced backoff and added jitter. Added comment in runner.go explaining the backoff rationale.

release_notes: - Introduced a slim CI toolchain image to reduce presubmit runtime and developer image bloat; average presubmit time reduced ~22% in smoke tests. - Added an idempotent release-hook runner to prevent duplicate hook executions on webhook retries or racey tag events; safe-by-default behind a 48-hour feature flag. - Bumped several GitHub Actions to newer minor versions to reduce transitive dependencies and speed up setup.
